KEY FEATURES
============

✅ Zero-malloc in metac (user provides buffer)
✅ Event-driven architecture (iterator + emitter)
✅ Stack-safe (heap-based traversal)
✅ Overflow detection (graceful -ENOSPC)
✅ Memory control (user owns buffer lifetime)
✅ Error handling (comprehensive error codes)
✅ API simplicity (3 public functions)
